framework_lessons: Distinguish operating gains from value realization.
assessment: Cornerstone supplies a concrete successful realization, qualified by the acquisition mechanism and trade-timing gap. Twilio is a speculative valuation case with no finite return target. The macro framework identified slowing growth and liquidity risk, but was too categorical about the impossibility of positive real rates and too relaxed about mortgage-rate sensitivity.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
